odysseyWorldGpuP50LaneBMs.note: Same measurement on the Radeon 610M / 1280x720 / Medium — the iGPU of this laptop, forced via --low-power. MEASURED AND DEFENSIBLE 2026-08-12: 9.895936 ms p50 (p95 10.49), cooled machine, nothing else on the GPU, station pinned, both baselines content-matched at 50 draws / 756,005 tris, baselineDrift EXACTLY 0.00 ms. The earlier 4.19 was the sticky-sampler artefact (ADR-0016). BASELINE STAYS NULL ON PURPOSE: committing 9.9 against max 7.0 reds the gate, and whether to close the 2.9 ms gap by optimisation or to re-budget the lane is the owner's decision — see the plan's section 7.1. Inputs for that decision: hiding the level-node group (with restored sparkles) saves 0.59 ms p50 and removes the tail (p99 18.9 -> 9.9), and the legacy dioramas measured 39.5-67.7 ms, so the rebuild's saving is not in question — only the last 2.9 ms against an aspirational budget.

odysseyWorldDrawCallsLaneA.note: Draw calls at the same station: 53 with One World, 124 with the dioramas. The count is the structural claim of the rebuild (one continuous surface, not four), so a regression here means chapter environments have crept back into Act II.
